messages:
maria-support: FYI escalated ticket #T-4721 — customer reports they were charged but the confirmation email referenced a different account. believes this started after recent assistant update that calls payment + user-notify tools in parallel. attaching redacted logs and repro steps.

alice-support: thanks, passing to eng. high priority: potential billing exposure :grimacing: — customer is mid-enterprise, legal looped.

maria-support: truncated log (redacted):
```
INFO request_id=rid_9f3a payment_tool_call_id=ptc_11 user_tool_call_id=utc_12
PAYMENT: charge.success {"tx_id":"tx_77","amount":49.99,"customer_id":"cust_redacted"}
USER_NOTIFY: notify.success {"email":"other@example.com","user_id":"user_999"}
ASSOC: tool_result_association failed: mapping mismatch for request rid_9f3a
```

henry-eng: can you paste the original assistant -> tool invocation payload (redacted) and the chronology? suspect multi-tool parallel association bug where results array indexing gets out of sync.

maria-support: pasted sample request (redacted):
```
POST /v1/assistant/call
{
  "input": "charge customer for invoice 987",
  "tools": ["payment_charge_v1","user_notify_v2"],
  "parallel": true,
  "metadata": {"customer_id": "cust_redacted", "email":"cust@acme.com"}
}
```

jordan-ml: quick theory: model->tool selector returns both tool calls with generated call_ids, but our multi-tool dispatcher uses positional mapping to reconstruct tool_result association. if any race reordering occurs (fast payment returns before user_notify) and we assume deterministic ordering, we can attach wrong tool result to the wrong tool_call_id.

karen-sre: observed spike in 2025-11-03T14:12Z on the multi-tool worker pool; saw interleaved responses in logs. example kv snapshot: `worker_7: resp_idx=0 tool_result_id=tr_7001`, `worker_8: resp_idx=0 tool_result_id=tr_7002` — looks like indexing isn't scoped per-request.

henry-eng: thanks. what I need to reproduce: full (non-redacted) request/response with correlation id rid_9f3a, and the per-tool call_id values. any chance customer can share full payload? otherwise we can try to replay with workload sim.

maria-support: customer will not share full PII, but approved safe replay. attaching replay script request_id and sample tokens in support secure bucket. repro steps I have: 1) send assistant call with parallel true and two tools (payment then notify) 2) send ~30 concurrent requests 3) observe ~1/200 that notify result attached to different request.

henry-eng: good repro. temporary mitigation: disable parallel tool execution for payment-related toolchains (set parallel: false) in routing rules for the tenant. can support toggle a feature-flag?

alice-support: we can flip tenant flag; need eng to patch until we ship fix.

jordan-ml: probable root cause: multi_tool_use dispatcher uses a shared response queue and reconstructs calls by popping results in arrival order into the original calls list. the original code: 
```
// pseudocode
for (i=0; i<call_count; i++) {
  results[i] = responseQueue.pop()
}
mapResultsToCallIds(results)
```
This assumes responseQueue is isolated per-request — but in parallel worker pool it's global. fix: attach correlation token at enqueue and pop only items matching current correlation or use per-request queues.

henry-eng: agree. quick patch: include `request_trace_id` in every tool RPC and let queue.pop(filter=trace) or use a Map<trace, list> to collect responses. i'll spin up PR for hotfix.

karen-sre: deploy window? this impacts critical path. we should hotfix in canary and throttle rollout. also schedule rollback if telemetry worsens.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary -> infra/multi-tool-dispatcher hotfix v2025.11.05-hf1 by henry-eng.

henry-eng: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/dispatcher/pull/842 (hotfix) — adds request_trace_id to tool RPC, per-request response buffer, and guarded pop. also adds an assertion to detect cross-trace dequeueing.

alice-support: flipping tenant parallel=false for acct acme-corp now. customer notified: we recommended temporary pause on parallel tool usage for billing flows.

maria-support: customer confirms holds and is running the replay; initial checks show no new mis-associations after flag.

henry-eng: can someone attach a minimal repro script (sanitized) here so eng-qa can run CI? also add an integration test that simulates interleaved worker responses.

maria-support: added sanitized replay to the secure bucket path: s3://redwood-secure/support/replays/T-4721/replay_sanitized.sh and gave eng read access.

jordan-ml: added unit/integration tests to the PR that simulate 1000 concurrent calls with random latencies; failing before fix, passing after. also added telemetry metric `tool_result_mismatch_rate` and an alert threshold.

karen-sre: alert created: #alerts-842 mismatch_rate > 0.1% for 1m triggers paging. recommended retention 30d for traces.

deploy-bot: canary finished: 3 nodes, no new mismatches in canary window. rolling to prod.

henry-eng: deployed hotfix to prod. monitoring closely. will keep tenant flag in place for 24h then re-evaluate.

alice-support: customer legal is satisfied with temporary mitigation and hotfix timeline — they requested postmortem and preventative steps.

jordan-ml: postmortem draft: causal chain = shared/global response queue in multi-tool dispatcher + parallel worker pool + positional result mapping. fix = per-request correlation tokens + per-request buffer + tests + new telemetry. preventative = add contract tests for multi-tool calls, and require correlation token in tool RPC.

maria-support: thanks team. leaving this thread open until confirm 48h clean window.

henry-eng: note for follow-up: consider making `parallel: true` opt-in for billing-sensitive toolchains in policy config, or add a vetting step in policy that disallows parallel when payment tools are present.

alice-support: noted. filing follow-up story in backlog. ticket #T-4721 -> closing after 48h clean. :white_check_mark:
